newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 13-week T-bill auction for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 13-week T-bill auction for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of 13-week treasury bills on Wednesday, the central bank (NBS) said on Monday.
Average yield in the last successful auction of 13-week T-bills on April 9 rose to 14.84 percent from 13.963 percent in a similar auction on January 23.
The ministry does not announce the amount of bills on offer at the auction, nor does it reveal its minimum or maximum price for bids.
Three-month funds on the Slovak interbank market were trading at an average 17.63 percent on Monday.
